case_manifest.rule: Every primary model must run EVERY case in this manifest. Cases are never reduced for one model; a case that cannot be run is recorded as a failure.

paired_completeness.policy: Formal paired comparison STOPS when case coverage differs across models. A complete-case subset may still be analysed, but every excluded case and model is reported above.

diagnostics.cap_relaxation_note: Pass 3 raised the per-group cap because the baseline cap could not satisfy the designed quota. Threads selected this way carry reason code SELECTED_RELAXED_GROUP_CAP and are concentrated in fewer source posts.

sampling.expansion_factor_note: PROHIBITED USE: these are descriptive ratios of eligible threads to selected threads. They are NOT formal inclusion-probability weights and MUST NOT be used as survey weights, nor to compute corpus prevalence, nor in any weighted estimator or variance calculation. Selection was coverage-greedy and group-capped, so true inclusion probabilities are neither uniform within a stratum nor known in closed form. Report pilot results as macro results over designed strata only.

post_disjointness.policy: Group separation is never relaxed silently. If a stratum is not feasible, the notebook reports it and the researcher must decide explicitly: enlarge the corpus, accept a smaller confirmation set, or record a protocol deviation.
